bootstrapUnit.exceptionReason: The current task controller cannot represent or claim the append-only amendment mechanism needed to repair its own Wave-approval and review-history controls.
requiredOutcomes: Repeated approval of an APPROVED Wave fails without changing any byte.
The original W1 approval and already-approved CAP-02 amendment are represented as an immutable base plus legacy W1.A01 with identical effective authority.
Backward-compatible ECR and amendment validation, approval-record, materialization, activation, status, and review-page controls exist and fail closed.
Only W1.A02.T01 and W1.A02.T02 can be materialized from this approved packet.
The bootstrap receives focused tests and independent control/security approval before task materialization or W1 resumption.
prohibitedOutcomes: No product code or researcher-facing experience change.
No change to evidence criteria, verification thresholds, canonical full profiles, release gates, or completed task outcomes.
No rewrite or deletion of a prior approval, review, evidence record, or Git object.
No ordinary W1 task claim while the Wave is paused for this amendment.

taskInventory.title: Immutable review packets and bounded remediation
taskInventory.objective: Preserve complete review truth while reducing repeated review administration through frozen packets, append-only attempts/findings, atomic submission, and bounded replay.
acceptanceCriteria: Every submission freezes candidate/evidence/criteria/changed-path/check-selection identity and one review round returns one consolidated severity-ranked finding ledger.
Review attempts and findings are append-only; final approval requires explicit closure of all blocking findings and cannot erase prior changes-requested dispositions.
Remediation replays open finding IDs plus incremental changed-path risk, with root-cause escalation after round two.
Evidence attachment plus submission is one compare-and-swap operation, while legacy task review readers remain truthful and backward-compatible.
Generated views show immutable packets, review rounds, findings, closures, and current projection without flattening history.
verification: Deny stale writers, altered packet/evidence hashes, self-review, duplicate attempts, approval with open blocking findings, unchanged-surface laundering, and dependency bypass.
Prove existing task histories validate without fabricated attempts and legacy latest-review projection remains supported.
Run focused taskctl schema/workflow/view tests, affected quality checks, and independent control review.

taskInventory.title: Affected verification selection and privacy-safe review telemetry
taskInventory.objective: Make risk-selected verification deterministic and inspectable while measuring review delay without collecting research content or weakening canonical profiles.
acceptanceCriteria: Affected selection records changed paths, selected commands, deferred commands, rationale, and the later gate that owns deferred coverage.
Unknown or safety-sensitive changes conservatively select broader coverage; canonical profiles and thresholds remain immutable.
Telemetry is limited to control IDs, timestamps, durations, outcomes, finding counts/severity, command IDs, and remediation linkage.
No prompt, source content, research data, secret, user-data path, free-form finding body, or chain-of-thought is collected, and no historical data is fabricated.
Wave exit still runs the complete affected/full repository and deployment-profile matrix.
verification: Prove deterministic selection, conservative fallback, canonical profile immutability, and deferred-gate ownership.
Probe telemetry payloads for forbidden content and verify no backfill is invented.
Run focused verify/taskctl/view tests, affected quality checks, and independent control/privacy review.

acceptanceCriteria: Pending and unapproved amendments cannot be materialized, activated, claimed, included by taskctl next, resumed, or used to approve G1.
Duplicate approval, wrong packet commit/hash, dirty state, changed base authority, missing human identity, stale writer, forked chain, and self-review fail closed.
W1 base plus migrated W1.A01 exactly reproduces the current effective W1 authorization.
Backlogs with no amendment collection remain valid unchanged and older tools fail closed when an active amendment is present.
Independent amendment review and a W1 control/security checkpoint are required before ordinary W1 execution resumes.
verificationObligations: Schema validation and exact listed-file SHA-256 verification for this inert packet.
Focused fail-closed tests for Wave reapproval, append-only approval concurrency, migration parity, materialization, activation, claim, resume, review history, and generated pages.
Affected foundation/schema/workflow/view/quality checks at task level, independent control/security review at bootstrap and amendment exit, and complete Wave-exit qualification later.
Performance measurement is run once at its declared gate and is never retried to green; this amendment does not change benchmark methods or thresholds.
rollback: Before activation, withdraw or defer the amendment without executable state while retaining immutable proposal and disposition history.
After bootstrap but before materialization, disable activation and retain approval/migration records.
After activation, pause the amendment, retain evidence, and restore the last validated executable projection through reviewed remediation; never erase historical authority or review records.
If legacy migration cannot reproduce current effective W1 authority, leave W1 paused and materialize no task.
nonGoals: No product feature, architecture, researcher workflow, UI reference, release gate, or external system change.
No weakening or deletion of independent review, task/slice acceptance criteria, security review, or full Wave-exit qualification.
No benchmark baseline, methodology, threshold, rerun policy, or canonical verification profile change beyond adding non-destructive selection metadata.
No parallel mutation of the campaign worktree and no general-purpose emergency override flag.
